secret.text: Save the secret now: the portal shows it once. A lost secret can only be rotated.
secret.label: Secret
secret.how: The X-Hub-Signature header looks like "t=time,v1=signature", time in seconds. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 of the string "time.request body" with this secret, in hex. The X-Hub-Delivery header stays the same across retries of one delivery.

rotate.text: The previous secret stops working at once. Requests will be signed with the new secret: update it on the receiver side.

test.text: The portal sends the test event with a sample body. It carries no request data. The result appears in the delivery log.

delete.title: Delete address {name}?
delete.text: The secret and the delivery log are deleted with the address. Rules that called this webhook will record the action as not done.

page.title: Sign in to Smartup Hub

confirmEmail.invalid: This link no longer works. Request a new one in your profile.
confirmEmail.taken: This address is already linked to another account. Enter a different address in your profile.
confirmEmail.signInRequired: To confirm the address, sign in to the portal in this browser with the account where you entered it, then open the link again.

telegram.title: Sign in to Smartup Hub
telegram.text: Press the button to sign in.
telegram.invalid: This link no longer works. A link from the bot works once and for 10 minutes. Request a new one in the bot.

auth.tooOften: Too many attempts from your address. Wait 10 minutes and press the button again.

loginLink.subject: Sign in to Smartup Hub
loginLink.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub, open the link and press "Sign in":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes and only once. If you did not ask to sign in, just delete this email.

confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your address for Smartup Hub
confirmEmail.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub with a link sent to this address, open the link and press "Confirm address":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes. If you did not enter this address, just delete this email: an unconfirmed address is not linked to anything.

invitation.subject: Invitation to Smartup Hub
invitation.text:
Hello,

{inviterName} invites you to the organization {orgName} in Smartup Hub, the Smartup support portal.

To accept the invitation, open the link and press "Accept":
{url}

The invitation is valid for {days} days.

telegramLinked.subject: Telegram is linked to Smartup Hub
telegramLinked.text:
Hello,

The Telegram account {account} is now linked to your Smartup Hub account. It can be used to sign in to the portal.

If this was not you, unlink it in your profile:
{url}

staffInvitation.subject: Invitation to the Smartup Hub workspace
staffInvitation.text:
Hello!

{inviterName} invites you to the workspace of Smartup Hub, the Smartup support portal.

Open the link, set a password and connect the second sign-in factor:
{url}

The link works for {hours} hours and only once. Do not forward it to anyone.

staffReset.subject: Your Smartup Hub access was reset
staffReset.text:
Hello!

The portal administrator reset your password and second sign-in factor in Smartup Hub. All your sessions have been ended.

Open the link, set a new password and connect the second factor again:
{url}

The link works for {hours} hours and only once. If you did not ask for a reset, tell the administrator.

layout.replyAbove: Reply to this email and your reply will be added to the request

ticketCreated.heading: Request SUP-{number} created
ticketCreated.text: We have received your request "{title}". You will get the answer by email and in the portal.
ticketCreated.viaEmail: We have received your email "{title}" and created request SUP-{number}. To add details, reply to this email.

ticketStatus.heading: News on request SUP-{number}
ticketStatus.waiting_customer: We are waiting for your reply on request SUP-{number} "{title}". Reply to this email or in the portal.
ticketStatus.in_development: Request SUP-{number} "{title}" has been passed to development. We will write when there is news.
ticketStatus.closed: Request SUP-{number} "{title}" is closed. If the question remains, write to us.
ticketStatus.autoClosed: Request SUP-{number} "{title}" is closed because we did not get a reply. If the question remains, write to us.
ticketStatus.merged: Request SUP-{number} has been merged with request SUP-{into}. The conversation continues there.
ticketStatus.rate: Rate how we helped (1 poor, 5 excellent):

ticketResolved.heading: Request SUP-{number} resolved
ticketResolved.text: We consider the question "{title}" resolved. Please rate the answer: it takes a minute. If something is wrong, reply to this email.

waitingReminder.heading: Waiting for your reply
waitingReminder.text: We are waiting for your reply on request SUP-{number} "{title}". Without a reply the request will be closed in {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}.

unidentifiedAck.subject: Your email has been received

unidentifiedAck.text: We have received your email. Request number: SUP-{number}. A support specialist will answer you by email.

staffMention.heading: You were mentioned in a note
staffMention.text: {author} mentions you in a note on request SUP-{number} "{title}".

staffBreach.heading: Deadline missed

staffBreach.resolution: The resolution deadline for request SUP-{number} "{title}" has been missed.

staffUpdateDue.heading: Time to update the client
staffUpdateDue.text: Tomorrow the regular update deadline expires for request SUP-{number} "{title}" in development. Write to the client what is known today.

ops.outbox_failed: Smartup Hub: emails and messages not sent in the last hour: {count}. Check the outbox.

ops.inbound_stuck: Smartup Hub: incoming emails not processed for more than 10 minutes: {count}.
